topics.title: Algebra Foundations
topics.description: Master linear equations, variables, and order of operations.

questions.question: Solve for x in the equation: 3x - 5 = 16
questions.explanation: Add 5 to both sides: 3x = 21. Then divide both sides by 3 to get x = 7.
hints: Start by isolating the x term. Add 5 to both sides of the equation.

questions.question: What is the slope of the line passing through points (2, 4) and (4, 10)?
hints: Use the slope formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1).

questions.question: What will be printed to the console after running this code?
questions.explanation: The .push() method appends an item to an array, increasing its length from 3 to 4.
hints: The .push() method adds an item to the end of an array.
Count how many total elements are in the array after 4 is added.
